description: This file defines the 'Constant' class, which represents a constant in a mathematical expression within a Java evaluation library. It stores a mnemonic name for the constant and provides a getter method. The class is used to facilitate the inclusion of named constants like pi or e in expressions.

classes.name: Constant
classes.description: Represents a constant with a mnemonic name used in expressions.

methods.name: Constant
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the constant with a mnemonic name.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the mnemonic name of the constant.
